description.en:
Like CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_TOUGH, but with only one protection: the player's commands stop costing TP while their Fighting Spirit is not out. GP loss and Fighting Spirit gauge costs still apply.
It uses the same tough list as SET_FORCE_TOUGH, so calling one after the other for the same player replaces that player's protections. CMND_BTL_RESET_FORCE_TOUGH empties the list.

The player can be given in three ways, chosen by the number of arguments (same rules as CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN):
- 2 arguments (enable, charaId): by parameter ID.
- 3 arguments (enable, memberIndex, teamSlot): member number memberIndex of that team's match roster.
- 4 arguments (enable, slotOffset, teamSlot, any): whoever stands at position slotOffset among that team's players on the pitch. The fourth argument is not read.
Several match scripts use the 4-argument form in a loop over positions 0 to 10 of team 1, so none of the opponent's eleven players pay TP.
true to waive the player's TP costs, false to remove them from the tough list.

2-argument form: parameter ID.
3-argument form: member number in the team's match roster.
4-argument form: position offset among the team's players on the pitch.
3- and 4-argument forms: team of the player, 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
Only there to select the 4-argument form; never read. The scripts pass true.

examples.case: No TP costs for the whole opponent team (real usage, from btl1024.nut)
